violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. NO CFM PRESENT DURING INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. EMPLOYEE STATED CFM IS OUT OF TOWN. A FOLLOW UP INSPECTION WILL OCCUR TO VERIFY A CFM IS PRESENT DURING ALL HOURS OF OPERATION. ADDITIONAL STAFF MUST OBTAIN CFM CERTIFICATION.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Water Temp
violations.observation: OBSERVED MAXIMUM HOT WATER TEMPERATURE AT HAND SINK OF 90F.
violations.corrective_action: A handwashing sink shall be equipped to provide water at a temperature of at least 100F through a mixing valve or combination faucet. ADJUST WATER HEATER/BOOSTER SO THAT HAND SINK IS 100F.

out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: TPHC, Food Marked with 4 Hour End Point
violations.observation: The following food item(s) for which time rather than temperature is used as a control is not marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control: OBSERVED BOBA MARKED WITH NO 4 HOUR END POINT.
violations.corrective_action: If time only, rather than time in accordance with temperature control, up to a maximum of 4 hours, is used as the public health control the food shall: 1) have an initial temperature of 41F or less if removed from cold holding temperature OR 135F or above if removed from hot holding temperature control, 2) be marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, 3) be cooked and served, served if ready-to-eat, or discarded within 4 hours from the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, and 4) be discarded if unmarked or marked to exceed a 4 hour limit. EHS ASSISTED EMPLOYEE IN MARKING 4 HOUR END POINT.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Manual Wash Water Temperature
violations.observation: OBSERVE MAXIMUM HOT WATER AT 3 COMPARTMENT SINK 103F.
violations.corrective_action: The temperature of the wash solution for manual WAREWASHING must be no less than 110F. ADJUST HOT WATER BOOSTER SO HOT WATER IS MINIMUM 110 AT 3 COMPARTMENT SINK

violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. No CFM present during inspection.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. A CFM must be present during all hours of operation. Have staff obtain CFM or L-CFM certification. A follow up inspection will be conducted on or around 10 days to verify a CFM is present.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Water Temp
violations.observation: Observed hand sink hot water at 78F.
violations.corrective_action: A handwashing sink shall be equipped to provide water at a temperature of at least 100F through a mixing valve or combination faucet. A follow up inspection will occur on or around 10 days to verify the hand sink hot water is able to reach 100F.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Manual Wash Water Temperature
violations.observation: Observed hot water from 3 compartment sink at 102F.
violations.corrective_action: The temperature of the wash solution for manual warewashing machine must be no less than 110F or the temperature specified on the cleaning agent manufacturer's label instructions. EHS will conduct a follow up inspection on or around 10 days to verify hot water at 3 compartment sink is able to reach 110F.
